punchline: Attia names four diseases that most of us will die of, and one early signal that may warn of all of them.
thirty_sec: Attia says most people will die of one of four chronic diseases: heart disease, cancer, Alzheimer's or type 2 diabetes. He treats metabolic health as foundational and calls raised insulin the canary in the coal mine. Insulin resistance goes with higher risk of the others, an association, so he argues for checking early signals instead of waiting.
